title: Insight ERC-8004 evidence descriptor (v1)
description: How Insight pre-trade artifacts anchor into ERC-8004 agent trust registries. This descriptor is documentation, not a signed object: every piece of evidence below is independently signed by Insight under its own EIP-712 domain and verifiable at the listed endpoints.

oracleSafetyAttestationV2.description: EIP-712 typed attestation (26 signed fields, stable UID) covering a pre-trade decision-input check: verdict, quorum (>=3 independent providers), independence (>=2 non-derived operator groups), request/provider/reason-code commitments, and a bounded validity window (600s).

verify.note: Offline-verifiable with viem/ethers using the domain and types below; the endpoint is a convenience.

erc8004Usage.validationRegistry: Submit the attestation UID and requestHash as validationResponse evidence for a trade-execution validation request; third parties re-derive the UID from the signed fields.
erc8004Usage.reputationRegistry: Reference the attestation (feedbackURI) when leaving feedback about an agent's decision quality; the UID binds the feedback to a concrete, signed check.

x402QualityReceiptV0.description: Draft JSON-schema quality-attestation artifact generated from live paid receipts (verdict, response timing, settlement facts). Reference implementation for the x402 quality-attestation discussion, not an adopted standard.

erc8004Usage.reputationRegistry: Attach as feedbackURI artifacts describing service quality the agent experienced.

binding.agentIdentity: The paying agent's EVM address (x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE payer) is recorded in the settlement audit row; on ERC-8004 networks the same address SHOULD hold the agent's identity token, which binds evidence to the ERC-8004 agentId without exposing the agent's key.
binding.scope: Challenge scope binds each payment to the exact resource (REST URL, or MCP tool name + canonicalized arguments), so receipts cannot be replayed against different requests.
